official_context.basis: Official model descriptions and reasoning-effort guidance; no measured price, latency or project-specific performance guarantee

runtime_rule: Inspect actual account/runtime model and native-agent availability. Requested identity is not observed identity; record substitutions and actual executor. Do not fabricate native delegation or independent review.

coordinator.scope: Goal framing, critical-path decisions, scientific contracts and bounded continuation

mechanical_worker.scope: Frozen-contract Rust implementation, source/HPC orchestration, bounded runs, plots and report assembly
mechanical_worker.escalation: Use high only for observed stiffness, unit/clock or energy-ledger debugging; return physical interpretation or contract changes to physics authority

focused_explorer.scope: Narrow extraction, schema/index assembly and factual source lookup; no scientific tolerance/closure invention

independent_reviewer.scope: Review actual diff/raw results it did not implement
independent_reviewer.escalation: Use xhigh / Extra high only for an isolated hard physics or numerical issue with observed need

AX00.scope: Reuse already completed goal/audit; no replay

existing_role_configs.rule: Recommendations do not rewrite reviewed role TOMLs or user global config

quality_priority.scope: When operating in a single-model environment; retain frozen contracts and report any lack of independent scientific review

cost_priority.scope: Use independent Astra review for physics/acceptance/final claims when available; do not treat self-review as independent

execution_notes: Explicit DAG and observed native 2–4 disjoint writers provide project parallelism; Ultra is not required
NCP64/128 is Rust solver compute, not LLM hosting; reasoning effort does not accelerate numerical time integration
Preserve preparation/run budgets, cumulative counters, checkpoints, frozen task scope and current coordinator push policy
Model recommendation does not alter scientific acceptance, node dependencies, optional OFF status or actual goal-completion criteria
